description: This Java source file defines the NotePadProvider class, a content provider for an Android note-taking app. It manages access to a notes database, providing CRUD operations, stream data functions, and URI routing for note items.

classes.name: NotePadProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider managing notes stored in an SQLite database, supporting data queries, modifications, streaming, and URI matching.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: Helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper, manages creation and upgrade of the notes database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the content provider, creating a DatabaseHelper instance.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles querying the notes database based on URI patterns and parameters.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given URI.

methods.name: getStreamTypes
methods.description: Provides supported data stream types for specific URIs.

methods.name: openTypedAssetFile
methods.description: Provides access to a note as a textual data stream for supported MIME types.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Converts note data into a text stream sent back via a pipe.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes notes from the database based on URI and criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing notes in the database according to provided values and URI.
